caption: 🧀 Toddler Sweet Potato Cheese Sticks 🍠 ✨ Ingredients: • 1 medium sweet potato, steamed • 2 tbsp flour • 2 cheese sticks • Olive oil, butter, or egg wash ✨ Directions: • Peel & steam sweet potato until fork tender. • Mash and mix in flour until a dough forms. • Divide into 2 balls and flatten. • Place a cheese stick in the center and seal the edges. • Brush with olive oil, butter, or egg wash. • Air fry at 350°F for 10–15 minutes, flipping halfway. • If cheese leaks out, just push it back in after cooking. • Let cool before serving. 🍅 Delicious with marinara for dipping (I was out, but my toddler still loved them!).
